title: Merged pickup popups above the player
player_outcome: Picked-up items float up from your head as 'Wood (37)' in rarity colour. Mining a vein bumps one growing popup with a little pop instead of flooding the screen. Coins merge into one line in coin colours ('1 gold 23 silver').
design:
New game/UI/Hud/PickupPopups.cs with 8 pooled Labels (18 px, outlined).
- Anchor: in third person, `Camera3D.UnprojectPosition(player head + 0.9 m)`. In first person, or when the point is behind the camera, a fixed screen point (W/2, H·0.38).
- Active popups stack upward 22 px apart.

Merging: key = 'coins' for coin items, otherwise (item id, prefix id).
- A repeat within 2 s adds to the count, resets the timer, and pops the scale 1.25 → 1 over 0.12 s.
- Text: '{prefix} {name} ({n})', or Coins.Format(total) coloured by Coins.TopTier.
- Each popup rises 40 px over 1.5 s and fades over the last 0.5 s.
The GameWorld.ItemPickedUp handler moves from Hud toasts (Hud.cs:161-164) to PickupPopups.
files_modify: game/UI/Hud.cs — create PickupPopups; drop the pickup toast
verification: Lavapipe exec in third person (`camera third`) mining a vein: a single growing popup
risks: UnprojectPosition near the screen edge; clamp to the viewport.
